text: R09 supersession by reference (lead approval 2026-11-02; Peter's rule: test bounds are not changed): attempt 2 of replica-admission-from-committed-operation deletes CDC_DEFAULTS.CACHE_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS with the write-path cache wait. The fresh-formation predicate (g) bound keeps its preregistered value, 1000 ms, now declared in test/distributed/harness/fresh-formation-routability-predicate.js as PROJECTION_PERSISTENCE_BOUND_MS (was read from CDC_DEFAULTS.CACHE_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 1000). The CACHE_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS log observation is kept (expected count zero after attempt 2). One observation is added: partition_execution_deadline, the existing typed wait that answers a routed write that cannot reach its commit; attempt 2 introduces no new wait name for commit unavailability. No other line of the reproducer changes; no bound is widened.
